function.name: convert_units
function.description: Convert a quantity between units of the same kind (volume to volume, weight to weight, temperature, time). Returns an error for volume<->weight. Cups/pints/quarts are US customary.

function.name: total_ingredient
function.description: Total amount of one ingredient across all steps of the current recipe, plus the per-step breakdown.

name.description: Ingredient name or part of it, e.g. 'butter'
